scope: Exactly original NextQA rows0..199; four conditions; no VATEX or automatic expansion

paired_WUPS.estimand: Similarity minus random; bootstrap over source-video clusters, conditional on fixed seeds 0,1,2

bootstrap.pairing: Same cluster draws for all conditions, conditional on fixed random seeds 0,1,2

audit.checks: Original Arrow/row/video identity, four-condition input/candidate bytes, original masks, global/effective counts and token merge work, native prefill shapes, seed ranking and nonselection configuration

metric: Unchanged native NextQA WUPS@0 aggregate in 0-100 points; negative paired differences are retained
interpretation: Global Random-head changes head identities and layer allocation under the same global quotas and merge work. Three seeds are not additional independent inputs; sample SD and input-cluster CI describe different uncertainty. This prefix alone does not establish general superiority.

generation_contract.input_policy: Original prefix, one CPU preparation per row, same tensors for all four conditions; no persistent tensor cache
generation_contract.commit_policy: Atomic complete four-condition bundle; no partial sample is a committed result
